verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents a menu-based auto attendant with text-to-speech greetings, ring groups, voicemail transcription, and AI-powered note-taking. None of these is an AI agent that answers calls, takes a message conversationally, and hands off to a human. These are adjacent IVR, routing, and transcription features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human
